shortDescription: Create an PRA application segment in the ZPA Cloud.

options.name: bypass_type
options.description: Indicates whether users can bypass ZPA to access applications.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication. Required for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication. Used for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false and not using private_key.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The ZPA cloud provisioned for your organization. Used for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false.

options.name: common_apps_dto
options.description: Configuration of common applications, e.g., inspection or Browser Access.

options.name: customer_id
options.description: The ZPA tenant ID found in the Administration Company menu in the ZPA console. Used for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the application.

options.name: domain_names
options.description: List of domains and IPs.

options.name: double_encrypt
options.description: Whether Double Encryption is enabled or disabled for the app.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether this application is enabled or not.

options.name: fqdn_dns_check
options.description: If set to true, performs a DNS check to find an A or AAAA record for this application.

options.name: health_check_type
options.description: health check type.

options.name: health_reporting
options.description: Whether health reporting for the app is Continuous or On Access. Supported values are NONE, ON_ACCESS, CONTINUOUS

options.name: icmp_access_type
options.description: Indicates the ICMP access type.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the application.

options.name: inspect_traffic_with_zia
options.description: Indicates if Inspect Traffic with ZIA is enabled for the application When enabled, this leverages a single posture for securing internet/SaaS and private applications and applies Data Loss Prevention policies to the application segment you are creating

options.name: ip_anchored
options.description: Whether Source IP Anchoring for use with ZIA, is enabled or disabled for the app.

options.name: is_cname_enabled
options.description: Indicates if the Zscaler Client Connector (formerly Zscaler App or Z App) receives CNAME DNS records from the connectors.

options.name: microtenant_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the application.

options.name: passive_health_enabled
options.description: passive health enabled.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication. Used for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false and not using client_secret.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: segment_group_id
options.description: ID of the segment group.

options.name: select_connector_close_to_app
options.description: Whether the App Connector is closest to the application (True) or closest to the user (False).

options.name: server_group_ids
options.description: ID of the server group.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: tcp_keep_alive
options.description: Indicates whether TCP communication sockets are enabled or disabled.

options.name: tcp_port_range
options.description: List of tcp port range pairs, e.g. [22, 22] for port 22-22, [80, 100] for 80-100.

options.name: tcp_port_ranges
options.description: The list of TCP port ranges used to access the application

options.name: udp_port_range
options.description: List of udp port range pairs, e.g. ['35000', '35000'] for port 35000.

options.name: udp_port_ranges
options.description: The list of UDP port ranges used to access the application

options.name: use_in_dr_mode
options.description: Whether or not the application resource is designated for disaster recovery

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client. When true, uses zpa_client_id/zpa_client_secret/zpa_customer_id/zpa_cloud for authentication. When false (default), uses client_id/client_secret/private_key with vanity_domain for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows. Required for OneAPI client authentication when use_legacy_client=false.

options.name: zpa_client_id
options.description: The ZPA API client ID generated from the ZPA console. Required for legacy client authentication when use_legacy_client=true.

options.name: zpa_client_secret
options.description: The ZPA API client secret generated from the ZPA console. Required for legacy client authentication when use_legacy_client=true.

options.name: zpa_cloud
options.description: The ZPA cloud provisioned for your organization. Required for legacy client authentication when use_legacy_client=true.

options.name: zpa_customer_id
options.description: The ZPA tenant ID found in the Administration Company menu in the ZPA console. Required for legacy client authentication when use_legacy_client=true.

options.name: zpa_microtenant_id
options.description: The ZPA Microtenant ID found in the Administration Company menu in the ZPA console. Used for legacy client authentication when use_legacy_client=true.
